title: 真实Operator旧Ready误判：按当前代数应用下游配置，控制器未观察前不得确认就绪
source: 独立编审：控制器特有故障根因
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。

验证重启/重试后可收敛

conversion.original_title: 用户更新到generation 9，界面仍Ready=True但observedGeneration是8，下游部署实际未升级。如何桌面处置？

body:
## 操作任务
用Go实现Reconcile(request,path,initial)(bool,error)，Request访问本题真实API。读取当前Widget CR及initial.deployment_path指定的已拥有Deployment，核对controller owner UID；将CR.spec.image同步到容器配置。只有实际Deployment.status.observedGeneration追上其metadata.generation且Available=True，才可写当前CR代数的Ready=True；更新未完成写False/Progressing，API拒绝更新写False/ApplyFailed，不能沿用旧Ready或只抄新代数。状态PUT使用读到的resourceVersion，不覆盖并发冲突；保留其他Condition及CR标签，状态未变化时不重复写。题目明确采用replicas=0的控制器状态教学合同，不能据此声明业务Pod健康。

## 提交产物
task.go

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
实际Go编译、TLS认证API、etcd持久CRD/CR/status与Deployment/ReplicaSet控制器。CR通过真实spec更新从generation8到9，初始旧Ready=True与下游v8确实存在；暂停本次私有控制器形成确定的观察延迟，API应用v9后必须False，恢复控制器真实观察后才能True；generation10的空image实际被API拒绝，保留v9下游且ReadyFalse。replicas明确0，零Pod、无镜像构建或拉取，Ready只证明本题零副本控制器状态合同，不证明业务流量/容器健康。其他Condition、标签和私有kubeconfig保留，默认身份/context/namespace不变；不修改真实集群。

"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-pilot-k8s-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

import copy,datetime,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,signal,subprocess,sys,time
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/"checks"))
from private_api import Cluster
from operator_go import GoClient
assert os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
cluster=Cluster.__new__(Cluster);cluster.processes=[];controller=None;log=None
try:
 with GoClient('ready,callErr:=Reconcile(request,c.Path,c.Initial);result["ready"]=ready') as client:
  cluster.__init__();root=cluster.root;ns='generation-review';cluster.namespace(ns)
  config=root/'controller-kubeconfig.json';config.write_text(json.dumps(dict(apiVersion='v1',kind='Config',clusters=[dict(name='private',cluster={'server':cluster.url,'certificate-authority':str(root/'ca.crt')})],users=[dict(name='admin',user={'client-certificate':str(root/'admin.crt'),'client-key':str(root/'admin.key')})],contexts=[dict(name='private',context={'cluster':'private','user':'admin','namespace':ns})],**{'current-context':'private'})));config.chmod(0o600)
  config_hash=hashlib.sha256(config.read_bytes()).hexdigest();default=os.environ.get('KUBECONFIG')
  log=(root/'controller.log').open('wb');controller=subprocess.Popen(['kube-controller-manager','--kubeconfig='+str(config),'--authentication-kubeconfig='+str(config),'--authorization-kubeconfig='+str(config),'--leader-elect=false','--use-service-account-credentials=false','--controllers=deployment,replicaset','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port=0','--root-ca-file='+str(root/'ca.crt'),'--v=0'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  def req(method,path,body=None):
   code,result=cluster.request(method,path,body);assert code<300,(code,result);return result
  def wait(fn,seconds=22):
   deadline=time.monotonic()+seconds
   while time.monotonic()<deadline:
    assert controller.poll() is None,(root/'controller.log').read_text()[-2000:]
    found=fn()
    if found:return found
    time.sleep(.1)
   raise AssertionError('actual controller/CRD observation deadline')
  crd=dict(apiVersion='apiextensions.k8s.io/v1',kind='CustomResourceDefinition',metadata=dict(name='widgets.training.opsforge.invalid'),spec=dict(group='training.opsforge.invalid',scope='Namespaced',names=dict(plural='widgets',singular='widget',kind='Widget'),versions=[dict(name='v1',served=True,storage=True,subresources=dict(status={}),schema=dict(openAPIV3Schema={'type':'object','properties':{'spec':{'type':'object','properties':{'image':{'type':'string'}}},'status':{'type':'object','x-kubernetes-preserve-unknown-fields':True}}}))]))
  crdpath='/apis/apiextensions.k8s.io/v1/customresourcedefinitions/widgets.training.opsforge.invalid';req('POST',crdpath.rsplit('/',1)[0],crd)
  wait(lambda:any(c['type']=='Established' and c['status']=='True' for c in (req('GET',crdpath).get('status',{}).get('conditions') or [])))
  collection='/apis/training.opsforge.invalid/v1/namespaces/'+ns+'/widgets';path=collection+'/sample';cr=req('POST',collection,dict(apiVersion='training.opsforge.invalid/v1',kind='Widget',metadata=dict(name='sample',labels={'audit':'preserved'}),spec=dict(image='registry.invalid/unused:v1')))
  for version in range(2,9):cr['spec']['image']='registry.invalid/unused:v'+str(version);cr=req('PUT',path,cr)
  assert cr['metadata']['generation']==8
  child_path='/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/'+ns+'/deployments/managed'
  dep=req('POST',child_path.rsplit('/',1)[0],dict(apiVersion='apps/v1',kind='Deployment',metadata=dict(name='managed',ownerReferences=[dict(apiVersion=cr['apiVersion'],kind='Widget',name='sample',uid=cr['metadata']['uid'],controller=True)]),spec=dict(replicas=0,selector=dict(matchLabels={'app':'generation-fixture'}),template=dict(metadata=dict(labels={'app':'generation-fixture'}),spec=dict(containers=[dict(name='app',image=cr['spec']['image'],imagePullPolicy='Never')])))))
  def deployed():
   d=req('GET',child_path);return d if d.get('status',{}).get('observedGeneration')==d['metadata']['generation'] and any(c['type']=='Available' and c['status']=='True' for c in d.get('status',{}).get('conditions',[])) else None
  wait(deployed)
  stamp=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat();audit_condition=dict(type='AuditApproved',status='True',reason='UnrelatedApproval',message='preserve',lastTransitionTime=stamp)
  cr=req('GET',path);cr['status']=dict(observedGeneration=8,conditions=[dict(type='Ready',status='True',reason='Reconciled',message='Reconciled',observedGeneration=8,lastTransitionTime=stamp),audit_condition]);cr=req('PUT',path+'/status',cr)
  cr['spec']['image']='registry.invalid/unused:v9';cr=req('PUT',path,cr);assert cr['metadata']['generation']==9 and cr['status']['conditions'][0]['status']=='True' and cr['status']['observedGeneration']==8
  assert req('GET',child_path)['spec']['template']['spec']['containers'][0]['image'].endswith(':v8')
  controller.send_signal(signal.SIGSTOP)
  print('NATIVE_OLD_READY_TRUE_GENERATION8_WITH_REAL_CR_GENERATION9_AND_CHILD_VERSION8_REPRODUCED',flush=True)
  result=client.run(cluster,path,initial={'deployment_path':child_path});assert not result['error'] and result['ready'] is False,result
  current=req('GET',path);conditions={c['type']:c for c in current['status']['conditions']};assert 'AuditApproved' in conditions,'unrelated approval condition was dropped';assert current['status']['observedGeneration']==9 and conditions['Ready']['status']=='False' and conditions['Ready']['observedGeneration']==9 and conditions['AuditApproved']==audit_condition
  assert req('GET',child_path)['spec']['template']['spec']['containers'][0]['image'].endswith(':v9')
  controller.send_signal(signal.SIGCONT);wait(deployed)
  result=client.run(cluster,path,initial={'deployment_path':child_path});assert not result['error'] and result['ready'] is True,result
  ready=req('GET',path);assert next(c for c in ready['status']['conditions'] if c['type']=='Ready')['observedGeneration']==9
  version=ready['metadata']['resourceVersion'];result=client.run(cluster,path,initial={'deployment_path':child_path});assert result['ready'] is True and req('GET',path)['metadata']['resourceVersion']==version
  ready['spec']['image']='';failed=req('PUT',path,ready);assert failed['metadata']['generation']==10
  result=client.run(cluster,path,initial={'deployment_path':child_path});assert not result['error'] and result['ready'] is False,result
  final=req('GET',path);conditions={c['type']:c for c in final['status']['conditions']};assert conditions['Ready']['status']=='False' and conditions['Ready']['reason']=='ApplyFailed' and conditions['Ready']['observedGeneration']==10 and conditions['AuditApproved']==audit_condition
  assert req('GET',child_path)['spec']['template']['spec']['containers'][0]['image'].endswith(':v9') and final['metadata']['labels']=={'audit':'preserved'}
  assert not req('GET','/api/v1/namespaces/'+ns+'/pods')['items'] and hashlib.sha256(config.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==config_hash and os.environ.get('KUBECONFIG')==default
  print('NATIVE_GENERATION9_REAL_CHILD_APPLY_NOT_READY_UNTIL_CONTROLLER_OBSERVES_FAILURE10_FALSE_PRIOR_DEPLOYMENT_AND_UNRELATED_CONDITION_PRESERVED_NO_PODS_OR_IMAGE_PULL',flush=True)
finally:
 if controller is not None:
  if controller.poll() is None:
   controller.send_signal(signal.SIGCONT);controller.terminate()
  try:controller.wait(timeout=4)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:controller.kill();controller.wait()
 if log is not None:log.close()
 cluster.close()
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
